title: SandboxExecutor boot must not revoke its siblings' gateway tokens
description:
sandbox-executor.ts:533 calls issueRunToken per boot, and issueRunToken revokes ALL live tokens for the run_id (gateway.ts:309). With max_parallel > 1 the second worker starting cuts the first off with 403 run_token_revoked. adopt (:255) and cancel (:417) do the same.

run-workflow.ts:2615-2620 already documents this hazard and avoids it — so this is a known trap that the new executor walked into, not a novel discovery. The tests stub boot, which is why it is green.

This makes parallel dispatch on the cloud host impossible, and parallel dispatch is most of why the window work exists.

From pxc, finding 9b7001b1.
acceptance_criteria: Two workers dispatched under one run id both hold usable gateway tokens for their lifetimes, with a test that boots a second worker and then exercises the first's token
